Legal services / Insolvency

GEO for personal and corporate insolvency lawyers

Individuals in debt, company directors and creditors need different kinds of legal assistance. I examine which insolvency professionals AI recommends for each situation and whether the public evidence accurately describes the services offered.

  • Separate individual, company and creditor buyer intents
  • Correct procedure boundaries without universal debt-discharge promises
  • Verified professional descriptions supported by primary law

Personally led by Alexey Yakovlev, GEO/AEO consultant

Selection barriers

Why a promise to erase every debt is misleading

Russian Federal Law 127-FZ establishes distinct insolvency procedures and effects. Individual case outcomes depend on financial facts, proceedings and applicable exceptions.

01

Personal and corporate cases are conflated

Company insolvency differs from individual debt restructuring and realisation of assets. Creditors also require a separate form of legal work.

02

Guaranteed results replace real scope

Blanket promises of discharge, asset retention or court success are not supported for every client and should not be treated as evidence.

03

Legal counsel is presented as an insolvency administrator

Legal representation and a court-appointed administrator's role are different. Claimed status and duties must be verified.

Verifiable facts

Verifying a bankruptcy legal practice

Russian Law 127-FZ distinguishes personal and corporate proceedings. Public proceedings may offer case-specific reference points, but the existence of a case does not establish a particular firm's successful representation.

  • Actual work: individuals, companies or creditors, consultation and representation scope
  • Real practitioner details: appropriate professional roles and qualifications, without conflating legal counsel and administrators
  • Publishable legal explanations, engagement terms and permitted case records that do not expose confidential client finances

GAEO's legal-services research method informs these checks. Unrelated corporate or family-law cases are not presented as completed insolvency GEO results.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Can a firm promise that all debts will be discharged?+

No blanket promise applies to every case. The outcome follows the applicable procedure and individual legal circumstances.

Is a bankruptcy lawyer the same as an insolvency administrator?+

No. Lawyers provide legal services; administrators have specific statutory roles. Public profiles must accurately identify which role is involved.

Should individual and corporate insolvency use separate GEO pages?+

Usually yes when both are offered, because legal procedures, services and clients differ.

May a firm publish a client's insolvency results?+

Only with a valid legal basis, factual verification and respect for confidentiality. Avoid unnecessary personal financial details.

What is the GAEO price for insolvency specialists?+

GAEO's published audit and monthly plans apply. Scope depends on practice areas, jurisdictions and the agreed query matrix.
